targets.rawSql:
with verified as (select distinct_id, min(occurred_at_utc) verified_at from analytics.events where event_name='user verified' group by 1),
api_key as (select distinct_id, min(occurred_at_utc) key_created_at from analytics.events where event_name='api key created' group by 1),
first_request as (select distinct_id, min(occurred_at_utc) first_request_at from analytics.events where event_name='api request completed' group by 1)
select count(*) filter (where v.verified_at is not null) as "Verified",
       count(*) filter (where k.key_created_at is not null) as "Created key",
       count(*) filter (where r.first_request_at is not null) as "First request"
from verified v left join api_key k on k.distinct_id=v.distinct_id left join first_request r on r.distinct_id=v.distinct_id

with fr as (select distinct_id, min(occurred_at_utc) t from analytics.events where event_name='api request completed' group by 1),
fp as (select distinct_id, min(occurred_at_utc) t from analytics.events where event_name='payment completed' group by 1)
select count(*) filter (where fr.t is not null) as "Made first request",
       count(*) filter (where fp.t is not null) as "Paid"
from fr left join fp on fp.distinct_id=fr.distinct_id
select date_trunc('week', occurred_at_utc) as time, count(distinct distinct_id) as "Weekly active users" from analytics.events where event_name='api request completed' group by 1 order by 1

select coalesce(properties->>'model','unknown') as model, coalesce(properties->>'endpoint','unknown') as endpoint, count(*) as requests from analytics.events where event_name='api request completed' and occurred_at_utc > now()-interval '30 days' group by 1,2 order by requests desc
